नेदयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Approximating, bringing near.
 E. नेद for
अन्तिक nom. verb, शतृ aff.

नेदिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
 1. Very near.
 2. Clever.
 m. (-ष्ठः) A tree; (Alan-
[]
gium hexapetalum.)
 E. अन्तिक near, इष्ठन् affix of the superlative,
and the form irr.; also नेदीयस् with ईयसुन् aff.
नेदीयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Very near, nearest: see the last.
